title: Borat: sample participant release
summary: The sample release illustrates how a written disclaimer of reliance can interact with claims that a participant was induced to sign by misleading statements.
notes:
Examine the provisions describing the project, the rights granted, compensation, releases, and the participant’s disclaimer of reliance on representations concerning the film or its participants. The document gives concrete language against which the Psenicska reasoning can be tested.

The supplied sample is identified with separate litigation; it should not be presented as proof of every fact concerning the Psenicska plaintiffs’ own signing process. Keep the text’s scope, the particular alleged misrepresentation, and the distinction between a general merger clause and a specific disclaimer of reliance in view.

textbookImport.basis: Paraphrase of the actual Fall 2026 course supplement. The source retains its own date and legal context; no current-law verification.

topics.misrepresentation: The release makes the scope and effect of a disclaimer concrete.
topics.assent: The claimed inducement and the signed undertaking must be considered separately.
topics.parol-evidence: A disclaimer of reliance raises a distinct question from ordinary integration.
